title: I Become a Student
convention: 本次按传统教学中的限定分句结构分类：共用主语的并列谓语仍按一个主句处理；非谓语另注。现代语法也把许多不定式、分词结构称作非限定从句，所以这里的“简单句”不等于“没有任何从属结构”。
badgePolicy: 图一用于简单句，第 37 句简短回应同用图一但保留特殊标签。图二用于主从复合句、并列句、并列复合句，第 36 句直接引语同用图二但单独标注。两图是课堂分流标记，具体语法类型以文字标签为准。

references.title: Cambridge Grammar · Clauses: finite and non-finite
Cambridge Grammar · Reported speech: direct speech

sentences.text: It is possible to get an education at a university.
sentences.label: 简单句
sentences.reason: It is possible 是主句；to get… 是不定式结构。
sentences.note: 保留形式主语 it 与后置不定式的讲解。

sentences.text: It has been done; not often, but the fact that a proportion, however small, of college students do get a start in interested, methodical study, proves my thesis, and the following personal experience I have to offer illustrates it and shows how to get around the faculty, the other students, and the whole college system of mind-fixing.
sentences.label: 并列复合句
sentences.reason: 分号、but、and 连接主句；另有 that 内容从句和省略关系词的 I have to offer。
sentences.note: 先分出主句，再处理插入语、名词后的从句及 how to… 非谓语结构。

sentences.text: My method might lose a boy his degree, but a degree is not worth so much as the capacity and the drive to learn.
sentences.label: 并列句
sentences.reason: but 连接 My method might lose… 与 a degree is not worth…。
sentences.note: 两个完整主句形成转折；to learn 为不定式，比较部分按短语处理。

sentences.text: My method was hit on by accident and some instinct.
sentences.label: 简单句
sentences.reason: 单一主句 My method was hit on…；and 连接介词后的名词。
sentences.note: was hit on 是短语动词的被动式。

sentences.text: I specialized.
sentences.label: 简单句
sentences.reason: I + specialized，单一主句。
sentences.note: 可略过句法，保留词义。

sentences.text: With several courses prescribed, I concentrated on the one or two that interested me most and worked intensively on my favorites.
sentences.label: 主从复合句
sentences.reason: that interested me most 修饰 the one or two；I 的两个谓语共用主语。
sentences.note: with + 名词 + 过去分词是非谓语附加结构。

sentences.text: In my first two years, for example, I worked at English and political economy and read philosophy.
sentences.label: 简单句
sentences.reason: I 共用谓语 worked 与 read；and 没有引出新的主句。
sentences.note: 区分并列谓语与并列句。

sentences.text: At the beginning of my junior year I had several cinches in history.
sentences.label: 简单句
sentences.reason: I had several cinches…，句首是时间介词短语。
sentences.note: 句法可略读；cinches 在本文的含义另看词汇。

sentences.text: Now I liked history; I had neglected it partly because I rebelled at the way it was taught, as positive knowledge unrelated to politics, art, life, or anything else.
sentences.label: 并列复合句
sentences.reason: 分号连接 I liked… 与 I had neglected…；because 引出原因，其中又含 it was taught。
sentences.note: the way 后的从句修饰 way；as positive knowledge 为介词短语。

sentences.text: The professors gave us chapters out of a few books to read and be quizzed on.
sentences.label: 简单句
sentences.reason: The professors gave us chapters… 是唯一主句；to read and be quizzed on 是并列不定式。
sentences.note: 保留 chapters 与 read／be quizzed on 的关系；on 不可漏读。

sentences.text: Blessed as I was with a "bad memory," I could not commit to it anything that I did not understand and intellectually need.
sentences.label: 主从复合句
sentences.reason: Blessed as I was… 是 as 从句；that I did not understand… 修饰 anything。
sentences.note: 先还原前置的 Blessed；understand 与 need 共用 I 和否定助动词。

sentences.text: The bare record of the story of man, with names, dates, and irrelative events, bored me.
sentences.label: 简单句
sentences.reason: The bare record… bored me；with… 插入补充说明。
sentences.note: 长主语不等于复合句；先找 record 与 bored。

sentences.text: But I had discovered in my readings of literature, philosophy, and political economy that history had light to throw upon unhistorical questions.
sentences.label: 主从复合句
sentences.reason: that history had light… 是 discovered 后的内容从句。
sentences.note: 从句内的 to throw 是不定式；throw light upon 要连读理解。

sentences.text: So I proposed in my junior and senior years to specialize in history, taking all the courses required and those also that I had failed.
sentences.label: 主从复合句
sentences.reason: that I had failed 修饰 those；主句是 I proposed…。
sentences.note: taking… 是补充性的分词结构；required 为后置过去分词。

sentences.text: With this in mind I listened attentively to the first introductory talk of Professor William Cary Jones on American constitutional history.
sentences.label: 简单句
sentences.reason: I listened attentively… 是唯一主句；其余主要为介词短语。
sentences.note: with this in mind 不含限定谓语。

sentences.text: He was a dull lecturer, but I noticed that, after telling us what pages of what books we must be prepared in, he listed off some other references "for those that may care to dig deeper."
sentences.label: 并列复合句
sentences.reason: but 连接两个主句；noticed 后有 that 从句，内含 what…we must… 与 that may care…。
sentences.note: 区分主句转折、内容从句、嵌入的疑问内容和关系从句。

sentences.text: When the rest of the class rushed out into the sunshine, I went up to the professor and, to his surprise, asked for this memorandum.
sentences.label: 主从复合句
sentences.reason: When the rest… rushed out… 为时间从句；I went up… and asked… 为主句。
sentences.note: went 与 asked 共用主语 I；to his surprise 为插入语。

sentences.text: He gave it to me.
sentences.label: 简单句
sentences.reason: He gave it to me，单一主句。
sentences.note: 可略过句法。

sentences.text: Up in the library I ran through the required chapters in the two different books, and they differed on several points.
sentences.label: 并列句
sentences.reason: and 连接 I ran through… 与 they differed…。
sentences.note: required 是过去分词修饰语，不是第二个谓语。

sentences.text: Turning to the other authorities, I saw that they disagreed on the same facts and also on others.
sentences.label: 主从复合句
sentences.reason: that they disagreed… 为 saw 后的内容从句。
sentences.note: Turning… 的逻辑主语是 I。

sentences.text: The librarian, appealed to, helped me search the bookshelves till the library closed, and then I called on Professor Jones for more references.
sentences.label: 并列复合句
sentences.reason: and then 连接 librarian helped… 与 I called…；till the library closed 为时间从句。
sentences.note: appealed to 是被动分词补充语；helped me search 中 search 不带 to。

sentences.text: He was astonished, invited me in, and began to approve my industry, which astonished me.
sentences.label: 主从复合句
sentences.reason: which astonished me 是非限制性关系从句；前面三个谓语共用 He。
sentences.note: which 回指教授表示赞许这件事；不能把共用主语的谓语逐个算主句。

sentences.text: I was not trying to be a good boy; I was better than that: I was a curious boy.
sentences.label: 并列句
sentences.reason: 分号和冒号连接三个 I was… 主句。
sentences.note: 冒号后进一步解释 better than that；to be 是非谓语结构。

sentences.text: He lent me a couple of his books, and I went off to my club to read them.
sentences.label: 并列句
sentences.reason: and 连接 He lent… 与 I went off…。
sentences.note: to read them 表目的，逻辑主语为 I。

sentences.text: They only deepened the mystery, clearing up the historical question, but leaving the answer to be dug for and written.
sentences.label: 简单句
sentences.reason: 唯一主句是 They only deepened the mystery；clearing 与 leaving 均为分词。
sentences.note: 保留分词逻辑主语 They，以及 leave + 宾语 + 被动不定式的讲解。

sentences.text: The historians did not know!
sentences.label: 简单句
sentences.reason: The historians did not know，单一主句。
sentences.note: 感叹号不改变句子结构。

sentences.text: History was not a science, but a field for research, a field for me, for any young man, to explore, to make discoveries in and write a scientific report about.
sentences.label: 简单句
sentences.reason: History was… 是唯一主句；not… but… 连接两个表语名词短语。
sentences.note: for me／for any young man 提示不定式的逻辑主语；in 与 about 对应 field。

sentences.text: I was fascinated.
sentences.label: 简单句
sentences.reason: I was fascinated，单一主句。
sentences.note: 被动／形容词性表语的分析不影响本次分组。

sentences.text: As I went on from chapter to chapter, day after day, finding frequently essential differences of opinion and of fact, I saw more and more work to do.
sentences.label: 主从复合句
sentences.reason: As I went on… 为时间从句；I saw… 为主句。
sentences.note: finding… 为非谓语补充；as 在这里表示随着／当……时。

sentences.text: In this course, American constitutional history, I hunted far enough to suspect that the Fathers of the Republic who wrote our sacred Constitution of the United States not only did not, but did not want to, establish a democratic government, and I dreamed for a while—as I used as a child to play I was Napoleon or a trapper—I promised myself to write a true history of the making of the American Constitution.
sentences.label: 并列复合句
sentences.reason: 多个叙述主句与插入语相接，含 that 内容从句、who 关系从句、as 从句和 I was… 内容从句。
sentences.note: 先理清 I hunted／I dreamed／I promised 的叙述线；not only did not… 不是主谓倒装。

sentences.text: I did not do it; that chapter has been done or well begun since by two men: Smith of the University of Washington and Beard of Columbia.
sentences.label: 并列句
sentences.reason: 分号连接 I did not do it 与 that chapter has been…；冒号后是两个人名。
sentences.note: done 与 well begun 共用 has been，不能误算为两个完整主句。

sentences.text: I found other events, men, and eras waiting for students.
sentences.label: 简单句
sentences.reason: 主句是 I found other events, men, and eras…；waiting 为非谓语结构。
sentences.note: 保留 find + 宾语 + doing 的分析；不把 waiting 当成过去时谓语。

sentences.text: In all my other courses, in ancient, in European, and in modern history, the disagreeing authorities carried me back to the need of a fresh search for the original documents or other clinching evidence.
sentences.label: 简单句
sentences.reason: the disagreeing authorities carried me back… 是唯一主句。
sentences.note: 主要难点是介词短语层层修饰；disagreeing 与 clinching 为修饰语。

sentences.text: Of course I did well in my classes.
sentences.label: 简单句
sentences.reason: I did well in my classes，单一主句。
sentences.note: 可略过句法。

sentences.text: The history professors soon knew me as a student and seldom put a question to me except when the class didn't know the answer.
sentences.label: 主从复合句
sentences.reason: except when the class didn’t know… 含时间从句；knew 与 put 共用主语。
sentences.note: except 限定例外情形；不要把 and 两边误判成两个独立主句。

sentences.text: Then Professor Jones would say, "Well, Steffens, tell them about it."
sentences.label: 直接引语句
sentences.reason: Professor Jones would say 是引述部分；引号内 tell them… 是祈使句。
sentences.note: 单列为直接引语；Steffens 是称呼语，祈使句主语 you 通常不明说。

sentences.text: Fine.
sentences.label: 简短回应（非完整句）
sentences.reason: Fine. 是独立的简短回应，没有完整的主谓结构。
sentences.note: 单列为小句／非完整句；不硬补出唯一的省略原句。

sentences.text: But vanity wasn't my ruling passion then.
sentences.label: 简单句
sentences.reason: vanity wasn’t my ruling passion then，单一主句。
sentences.note: 句首 But 连接上下文，不会自动使本句成为并列句。

sentences.text: What I had was a quickening sense that I was learning a method of studying history and that every chapter of it, from the beginning of the world to the end, is crying out to be rewritten.
sentences.label: 主从复合句
sentences.reason: What I had 为融合关系结构作主语；sense 后两个并列 that 从句说明内容。
sentences.note: 两个 that 从句并列于名词内部，不等于两个主句；注意原文时态由 was 到 is。

sentences.text: There was something for Youth to do.
sentences.label: 简单句
sentences.reason: There was something… 为存在句；for Youth to do 是非谓语结构。
sentences.note: 保留 Youth 作为 do 的逻辑主语、something 作为 do 的逻辑宾语的说明。
